notes.note: Fix round 7 of the delivery-state change: the flush hook's 'chat gained a waiting row' trigger counts an invoking row as waiting and a chat as sendable only with no turn running (isTurnInFlight), so a claim and its deferred release no longer start the next send; a pass does not claim rows of a chat with a turn running; backstop: releaseDeferred stamps deferredAt, claimNext skips a row deferred less than OUTBOUND_DEFER_RETRY_MS (1.5s) ago, and the hook schedules one pass when the earliest wait ends; the lease comment no longer claims a delay. Rewrote the busy sentence: a queued message is not sent while a turn runs in its chat and goes when it ends; one tried anyway waits without spending an attempt and is not tried again for 1.5s, then retried once. Checked against the same code and tests.
